meta.name: subagent-driven-development
meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体并行执行独立任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前会话中同时推进多个独立实现任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute independent tasks in parallel with subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple independent implementation tasks concurrently in the same session

howto.what: Claude 会为每个独立任务创建一个全新的子代理来执行，任务完成后立即进行规范符合性和代码质量审查，最后对整个分支做全面审查。它不会在任务之间暂停询问你，而是连续执行所有任务。
howto.when: 当你有一个实现计划，且计划中的任务大部分相互独立，并且你希望在同一会话中执行时触发。

say.text: 请按照计划文件执行任务，每个任务使用独立的子代理。
say.note: Claude 会为每个任务创建新子代理，执行并审查。

say.text: 对任务3进行修复，使用更强大的模型。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a fresh subagent for each independent task, performs a task review (spec compliance + code quality) after each, and a broad whole-branch review at the end. It executes all tasks continuously without pausing to ask for confirmation between tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have an implementation plan with mostly independent tasks and you want to execute them in the current session.

say_en.text: Execute the plan file, using a fresh subagent for each task.
say_en.note: Claude will dispatch a new subagent per task, execute, and review.

say_en.text: Fix task 3 using a more capable model.
say_en.note: If review fails, Claude enters fix loop; rounds 4+ use a more capable model.
